A white or practically white, odourless powder. Freely soluble in water, in glycerol, and in propylene glycol. Incompatibility. The activity of sodium dehydroacetate may be reduced by alkaline pH or interaction with nonionic sur- factants. Profile Dehydroacetic acid and sodium dehydroacetate have some anti- fungal activity and have been used in the preservation of cosmet- ics and oral preparations.
